# libwebp 1.5.0 cwebp — mac-arm64

This directory contains the official `cwebp` binary extracted from:

https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/libwebp-1.5.0-mac-arm64.tar.gz

Source index:

https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/index.html

Files:

- `bin/cwebp` — vendored executable bundled into `OkBrainMacOSAgent.app/Contents/Resources/cwebp` by `scripts/build.sh`
- `archive.sha256` — SHA-256 for the downloaded official archive
- `archive.tar.gz.asc` — official detached signature downloaded with the archive
- `cwebp.sha256` — SHA-256 for the extracted `bin/cwebp`

Host used for vendoring: macOS arm64.
